description: Rigid-fragment RMSD: symmetry-aware MCS overlay RMSD (Å) of the maximum common substructure after MMFF94 minimization (TargetDiff Table 1 convention; TODO-22 metric #13, shipped 2026-09-18).
unit: angstrom (Å; mean +/- std across overlayable pool)
pool_source: Curated 10 organic drug-like SMILES (same pool as metrics/by_metric/vina_min_score.json — aspirin / ibuprofen / acetaminophen / caffeine / salicylic acid / indole / nicotine / biphenyl / ethanol / benzene)

conformer_prep.overlay_method: rdkit.Chem.AllChem.GetBestRMS with symmetrizeConjugatedTerminalGroups=True (symmetry-aware MCS overlay); falls back to rdFMCS.FindMCS + AllChem.AlignMol with explicit atomMap when GetBestRMS raises (no strict substructure match). Returns None when no common substructure with >= 3 atoms exists.

note: Rigid-fragment RMSD is the symmetry-aware MCS overlay RMSD after MMFF94 minimization. GetBestRMS raises RuntimeError when there is no strict substructure match; we catch this and fall back to rdFMCS.FindMCS + AllChem.AlignMol with an explicit atomMap derived from the MCS. Pairs whose MCS has fewer than 3 atoms (e.g. benzene-aspirin where only a single C-C bond is shared) are reported as errors (no rigid fragment).
